shortlist.label: lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive and CD138-positive and CD56-positive on pathological analysis

shortlist.label: diffuse large b cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH)

shortlist.label: lymphoepithelial carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity and EBV-positive on pathological analysis

shortlist.label: nasal lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic unilateral nasal obstruction with a polypoid mass and lymphoma markers on pathological analysis

shortlist.label: extranodal natural killer/t-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD56-positive and EBV-positive on pathological analysis, and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive markers, along with EBV-positive status and the absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, are characteristic of extranodal natural killer/t-cell lymphoma, which is also consistent with the nasal cavity involvement.

rejected.label: lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as the specific type of lymphoma is suggested by the markers and EBV status

rejected.label: diffuse large b cell lymphoma
rejected.why: CD20-negative and PAX5-negative results do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: lymphoepithelial carcinoma
rejected.why: The pathological analysis suggests a lymphoid neoplasm rather than a carcinoma

rejected.label: nasal lymphoma
rejected.why: Too general, as the specific type of lymphoma is suggested by the markers and EBV status
